cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0)
get_filename_component(pocket_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../.." ABSOLUTE)
list(APPEND ZEPHYR_MODULES "${pocket_root}")
if(POCKET_TEST_QUICKJS)
  add_library(pocket_test_quickjs STATIC "${POCKET_TEST_QUICKJS}/quickjs.c" "${POCKET_TEST_QUICKJS}/dtoa.c" "${POCKET_TEST_QUICKJS}/libregexp.c" "${POCKET_TEST_QUICKJS}/libunicode.c")
  target_include_directories(pocket_test_quickjs PUBLIC "${POCKET_TEST_QUICKJS}")
  target_compile_definitions(pocket_test_quickjs PRIVATE _GNU_SOURCE)
  set(POCKET_QUICKJS_TARGET pocket_test_quickjs)
  set(POCKET_QUICKJS_INCLUDE_DIR "${POCKET_TEST_QUICKJS}")
endif()
find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE})
project(pocket_driver_contracts)
target_sources(app PRIVATE ../contracts.c)
target_compile_definitions(app PRIVATE POCKET_ZEPHYR_NATIVE=1)
